entries.title: PMMA in pills sold as ecstasy, now found in the UK
entries.summary: Drug checking services in eight countries, including the UK, have found PMMA in pills sold as ecstasy (MDMA). It turns up on its own or mixed with MDMA. checkit! in Vienna found PMMA again in its 6 November report, in two pink and purple Trump pills (40 mg and 48 mg). PMMA takes much longer to kick in, so people think the pill is weak and take more, which can be deadly.
detected: in some samples also ketamine, caffeine or amphetamine
entries.testing_org: Drug checking services across Europe, including WEDINOS (UK), compiled by the TEDI network
entries.sample_ref: TEDI MDMA adulteration warning, update 20 October 2026. UK sample: WEDINOS W105398 (https://wedinos.wales/sample/w105398/). Update: checkit! report KW45 2026 (https://checkit.wien/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/checkit_Warnungen_2026_KW45.pdf), two pink and purple Trump pills, 40 mg and 48 mg PMMA
entries.location_detail: Austria, Belgium, Germany, Italy, the Netherlands, Spain, Switzerland and the United Kingdom. Logos seen so far: Trump, Red Bull, Club 555, Donkey Kong / Gorilla, Hulk, Abarth, Mitsubishi. The UK pill was grey with a Trump logo, stamped "280mg" (a marking, not the dose). WEDINOS gives its sample as grey and pink, with MDMA and PMMA both found, received 22 Sep 2026, postcode BN17. That is where the sample was sent from, not proof of where it was sold. Vienna, 6 Nov 2026: pink and purple Trump pills, "NL" on one side, score line on the back, about 595 to 610 mg.
entries.original_warning_level: Highest level warning issued by Trimbos (Netherlands), late August 2026
entries.why_classified: Several labs in eight countries have confirmed it, including in the UK, and checkit! found it again in Vienna in November. PMMA has caused deaths in Europe before, and the danger comes from re-dosing when the pill seems weak. That's why it stays an Alert.
entries.uncertainty: We don't know how widespread it is in the UK yet. A pill's look tells you nothing about what's in it: the same logo can contain different things.
advice: Get your pills tested before you take them. In the UK you can post a sample to WEDINOS.
If a pill feels weak or slow, don't take more. PMMA can take up to 3 hours to fully kick in.
Home reagent tests can miss PMMA when MDMA is also in the pill.
Watch for overheating, a very fast pulse, muscle stiffness, confusion or fitting. Call 999 straight away if you see them.
Don't use alone, and look out for your mates.

history.change: Approved by Sid

entries.title: Fake mephedrone: 4-CMC, 2-MMC and others sold as 4-MMC and 3-MMC in Europe and the UK
entries.summary: Drug checking services in the UK, Vienna, Berlin and Slovenia keep finding 4-CMC and other little-known chemicals in powder or crystal sold as mephedrone (4-MMC) or 3-MMC. checkit!'s 6 November report found 4-CMC, 2-MMC, NEP and alpha-PVP in samples sold as mephedrone or 3-MMC. WEDINOS has also found 4-CMC in UK crystal sold as MDMA and in pink "tusi", and 2-MMC in many UK samples sold as mephedrone.
entries.sold_as: Mephedrone (4-MMC), 3-MMC. In the UK also MDMA crystal and pink "tusi"
entries.sample_ref: checkit! report KW41 2026, DrogArt 9 Oct 2026, drugchecking.berlin 6 to 19 Oct 2026. Update: DrogArt 30 Oct 2026, dpDMC sold as 4-MMC (https://www.drogart.org/rezultati-in-opozorila/dpdmc-prodan-kot-4-mmc-na-darknetu/). Update: WEDINOS samples W106386, W106385, W106338, W106298, W105319, W104646, W104591, W104501, W105378. drugchecking.berlin 27 Oct 2026. Update 7 Nov: checkit! report KW45 2026. DrogArt 6 Nov 2026, 4-CMC sold as MMC and 2-MMC sold as 3-MMC in Ljubljana. WEDINOS 4-CMC: W106718, W103864, W102742, W101594, W102216 (sold as mephedrone), W102678, W102611 (sold as MDMA), W106741 (pink tusi). WEDINOS 2-MMC sold as MDMA: W103591, W103572
entries.location_detail: UK (WEDINOS postcodes for 4-CMC: CB4, RG1, SE17, SE01, N7, BH23, E1, G44, TW8, EC1, E9, E2, TN14, E20, HP10 and SY10. 2-MMC sold as MDMA: BH12 and BD10), Vienna (Austria), Berlin (Germany) and Slovenia (Ljubljana, and Maribor for the dpDMC sample, which was bought on the darknet as a brown crystal). UK postcodes are where samples were sent from, not proof of where they were sold.
entries.why_classified: Labs have confirmed it again and again through 2026, in the UK too, and it's now also turning up in crystal sold as MDMA. These chemicals are much less researched than mephedrone. 4-CMC is suspected of damaging nerve cells, and alpha-PVP is a strong stimulant linked to agitation and psychosis. We have no reports of serious harm linked to the UK samples, so we suggest it stays a Heads Up.
entries.uncertainty: We can't say how much of the mephedrone on sale in the UK is affected. Samples are chosen by the people sending them in. Many of the new UK samples were received in June to August and only collected now. checkit! only lists samples it flagged.
advice: Get it tested if you can. Crystal sold as MDMA can be a cathinone like 4-CMC.
If it looks, smells or feels different from what you expect, don't take more.
Start with a small amount and wait.
Don't mix with alcohol or other stimulants.
If someone overheats, has chest pain, a very fast heartbeat or seems very agitated or paranoid, call 999.

entries.title: Synthetic cannabinoids found in cannabis, CBD and THC vapes, including in the UK
entries.summary: Drug checking services in the UK, Austria, Germany and Slovenia keep finding synthetic cannabinoids in products sold as cannabis, CBD, HHC and THC vape liquid. WEDINOS has found them in 10 more UK samples, mostly THC or CBD vape liquids, plus an HHC tincture, a live resin distillate and weed. checkit!'s 6 November report found three synthetic cannabinoids on blotter-like paper. These chemicals are far stronger than THC.
entries.sold_as: Cannabis, weed, cannabis oil, live resin, CBD and THC vape liquid, HHC, hash. In the UK also nicotine vape juice and one sample sold as crack
entries.sample_ref: checkit! report KW41 2026 and earlier reports, DrogArt warnings 2026. UK: WEDINOS samples W105521, W105086, W104677, W104410, W105932, W106724, W106231, 100004581, W105023, W105974. Update 7 Nov: WEDINOS W104027, W103744, W103194, W102853, W103076, W102044, W102713, W102907, W102311, W076323. checkit! report KW45 2026
entries.location_detail: UK (WEDINOS postcodes G82, RM10, CF81, SR2, ME7, NE34, B11, AB12, AB24, LS18, RH12, L1, NE39, E13, PO73 and BS19), Vienna (Austria), Berlin (Germany), Ljubljana (Slovenia) and Czechia. UK postcodes are where samples were sent from, not proof of where they were sold.
entries.why_classified: Labs in several countries have confirmed it again and again this year, and a UK lab has now found it in 20 products not sold as spice, mostly vapes. Synthetic cannabinoids are many times stronger than THC and can cause collapse, seizures and psychosis. One person vaping a "CBD" liquid reported chest pains, an irregular heartbeat and loss of consciousness. That's why it stays an Alert.
entries.uncertainty: We can't say how much of the UK market is affected, as these samples were chosen by the people sending them in. Many of the new UK samples were received in June to August and only collected now. A product's look, smell or packaging won't tell you.
advice: Be wary of vapes, edibles and CBD products from unknown sellers.
If it hits much harder or faster than you expect, stop.
Start with a tiny amount and wait.
Don't use alone.
If someone collapses, fits, can't be woken or struggles to breathe, call 999 and put them in the recovery position if they're breathing.

history.change: Approved by Sid
Updated with WEDINOS UK samples and moved from Heads Up to Alert. Update approved by Jimmy
Updated with 10 more WEDINOS samples, mostly vapes, and checkit!'s 6 Nov report. Stays an Alert. Update approved by Jimmy

entries.title: Nitazene found in fake OxyContin tablets bought on the darknet
entries.summary: DrogArt in Slovenia has found metonitazene, a very strong synthetic opioid, in a tablet bought on the darknet as OxyContin (oxycodone). Metonitazene is a nitazene. DrogArt says it is about as strong as fentanyl and 25 to 50 times stronger than oxycodone. A tiny amount can stop someone breathing.
entries.sold_as: Oxycodone (OxyContin 80 tablets), bought on the darknet
entries.testing_org: DrogArt (Slovenia), tested by the National Laboratory of Health, Environment and Food (NLZOH)
entries.sample_ref: DrogArt warning 30 Oct 2026, "Potenten sintetični opiod prodan kot oksikodon na darknetu"
entries.location_detail: Tested in Slovenia. Bought on the darknet, so the seller could be anywhere. Round green tablet marked "80" on one side and "OC" on the other. This tablet has not been reported in UK results in our data, but WEDINOS has found nitazenes in other UK samples, including a fake M30 tablet.
entries.why_classified: A lab has confirmed a nitazene in a fake prescription painkiller. Nitazenes can kill in tiny amounts, and people buying oxycodone won't expect anything this strong. Fake tablets sold online can reach the UK by post. It's one sample from outside the UK, so it's a Heads Up rather than an Alert.
entries.uncertainty: This is one tablet. DrogArt didn't give the amount in it, and says tablets from the same batch may hold different amounts. We don't know where the seller is or whether the same tablets are on sale in the UK.
advice: Fake tablets can look exactly like real medicines. A pharmacy box or a marking like "OC 80" proves nothing.
Don't use alone, and don't all use at the same time, so someone can call for help.
Don't mix with alcohol, benzos, GHB/GBL or other opioids.
Carry naloxone. In the UK you can get it free from many drug services and some pharmacies.
If someone can't be woken, has slow or no breathing, or blue lips, call 999, give naloxone if you have it and put them in the recovery position.

history.change: Approved by Jimmy
Corrected the UK line, as WEDINOS has found nitazenes in other UK samples. Update approved by Jimmy

entries.title: 3-CMC sold as MDMA in Ljubljana and the UK
entries.summary: DrogArt in Slovenia tested white, see-through crystal sold as MDMA in Ljubljana. It was 97% 3-CMC, a synthetic cathinone, with no MDMA found. WEDINOS has now found 3-CMC in white granules sold as MDMA in the UK, and in a capsule sold as mephedrone. 3-CMC feels different from MDMA, and people who think their MDMA is weak may take more.
entries.sold_as: MDMA (crystal or granules). In one UK sample, mephedrone
detected: 3-CMC (97% in the DrogArt sample. WEDINOS gives no amounts)
entries.testing_org: DrogArt (Slovenia), tested by the National Laboratory of Health, Environment and Food (NLZOH), and WEDINOS (Wales, UK)
entries.sample_ref: DrogArt warning 30 Oct 2026, "3-CMC prodan kot MDMA v Ljubljani". WEDINOS samples W106451 and W104729
entries.location_detail: Ljubljana, Slovenia (white, see-through crystal). UK: WEDINOS postcodes S7 (sold as MDMA, white granules) and NP20 (sold as mephedrone, capsule). UK postcodes are where samples were sent from, not proof of where they were sold.
entries.why_classified: Labs in two countries have now confirmed it, including in the UK. DrogArt says 3-CMC has been linked to poisonings and deaths in five EU countries and is very addictive. It's still a small number of samples, so we suggest a Heads Up rather than an Alert.
entries.uncertainty: This is only a few samples. We don't know how much of it is around in the UK.
advice: Crystal sold as MDMA can be something else. Get it tested if you can.
Start with a small amount and wait at least 2 hours before taking more.
Don't mix with alcohol or other stimulants.
If someone overheats, has chest pain, a very fast heartbeat, a fit or seems very confused, call 999.

history.change: Approved by Jimmy
Updated with WEDINOS UK samples and moved from One to Watch to Heads Up. Update approved by Jimmy

entries.title: Nitazenes and fentanyl-type opioids found in UK heroin and a fake M30 tablet
entries.summary: WEDINOS has found nitazenes, very strong synthetic opioids, in more UK heroin and another blue tablet marked M30. The collector has now picked up 8 more samples, the latest published 4 November, mostly from Scotland. One heroin sample from Newport also held xylazine and medetomidine, two sedatives that naloxone won't reverse. These drugs can stop someone breathing in tiny amounts.
entries.sold_as: Heroin. Also blue tablets marked M30, sold as oxycodone or an unspecified opioid
detected: Medetomidine in some of the heroin samples
entries.location_detail: England, Wales and Scotland. Postcodes given with the samples: RH5 and BH14 (M30 tablets), ZE1, SA1, SM2 (two samples), TD12, G82, PH1 (two samples), EH7, KA11 and NP20. Those are samples sent in, not proof of where the drugs are sold.
entries.original_warning_level: No warning level. WEDINOS sample results
entries.why_classified: A UK lab has confirmed these opioids in 13 samples received between June and October, in England, Wales and Scotland. Nitazenes can kill in tiny amounts, and people buying heroin may not know they're there. Several people sending samples in reported loss of consciousness or an overdose. That's why it stays an Alert.
entries.uncertainty: Samples are chosen by the people sending them in, so we can't say how common it is. Effects are self-reported. WEDINOS doesn't give the amounts. Most of the new samples were received in June to August and only collected now. Sample 000239974-2 is a Welsh-language page and may be a copy of a sample we don't have in English.
advice: Don't use alone, and don't all use at the same time, so someone can call for help.
Carry naloxone. In the UK you can get it free from many drug services and some pharmacies.
Start with a very small test amount, even from a usual source.
Don't mix with alcohol, benzos, GHB/GBL or other opioids.

If someone can't be woken, has slow or no breathing, or blue lips, call 999, give naloxone if you have it and put them in the recovery position. Naloxone won't reverse xylazine or medetomidine, so still call 999 even if they start breathing.

history.change: Approved by Jimmy
Updated with 8 more WEDINOS samples, one with xylazine. Stays an Alert. Update approved by Jimmy

entries.title: Medetomidine found in UK heroin and in fake Valium tablets
entries.summary: WEDINOS has found medetomidine, a veterinary sedative, in 16 UK samples published since September. Four were white tablets sold as Valium, diazepam or temazepam, with medetomidine as the only drug found. Most of the rest were sold as heroin. It's not an opioid, so naloxone won't reverse it.
entries.sold_as: Heroin, street Valium, diazepam, temazepam and one sample sold as crack
detected: Often with heroin, caffeine and paracetamol
entries.location_detail: England, Wales and Scotland. Postcodes given with the samples include DD3, SA1 and DL1 (tablets), NP20, NP4, CF11, SM2, N7, G82, DG1, ZE1, EH22 and PH1. Those are samples sent in, not proof of where the drugs are sold.
entries.original_warning_level: No warning level. WEDINOS sample results
entries.why_classified: A UK lab has confirmed it in 16 samples from across Britain. People sending in tablets reported an irregular heartbeat, chest pains and in one case a seizure. It can sedate people heavily and naloxone won't reverse it, so it's easy to mistake for something else. That's why we suggest an Alert.
entries.uncertainty: We can't say how common it is, as these samples were chosen by the people sending them in. Effects are self-reported and can't be pinned on one drug. WEDINOS doesn't give the amounts.
advice: Tablets sold as Valium or diazepam can be something else. Get them tested if you can.
Don't use alone, and start with a small amount.
Don't mix with alcohol, benzos or opioids.

If someone can't be woken or is struggling to breathe, call 999 and put them in the recovery position. Still give naloxone if you have it, as opioids may be there too. Tell the paramedics a sedative may be involved.

history.change: Approved by Jimmy

entries.title: Stronger benzos in fake Valium and Xanax tablets across the UK
entries.summary: WEDINOS keeps finding stronger, little-known benzos in tablets sold as Valium, diazepam or Xanax, most often ethylbromazolam, with four more published on 6 November. It has also found tramadol, an opioid painkiller, in white tablets sold as Xanax or alprazolam, sometimes with no benzo at all. These are easy to overdo, especially with alcohol or other opioids.
entries.sold_as: Valium, diazepam, Xanax or alprazolam tablets
detected: Tramadol (an opioid) in some tablets sold as Xanax
Promethazine or chlorpheniramine in some samples
entries.sample_ref: WEDINOS examples W106617, W106314, W105986, W105205, W105141, W103696. Update 7 Nov: ethylbromazolam W106777, W106686, W106662, 000237731-2 (published 6 Nov). Tramadol in tablets sold as Xanax or alprazolam: W106182, W103425, W103033, W102304, W103149, W103026
entries.location_detail: England, Wales and Scotland. Dozens of postcode areas, including E, BH, CH, TR, WF, NP, L, N, CF, EH, BN and LA. Tramadol tablets: M11, YO24, SW4, BN16, SW6 and E3. Those are samples sent in, not proof of where the drugs are sold.
entries.original_warning_level: No warning level. WEDINOS sample results
entries.why_classified: A UK lab keeps confirming this, month after month, across Britain. These benzos are less researched than diazepam, and the dose in a tablet is unknown. Tramadol in fake Xanax adds an opioid people won't expect, which raises the risk with alcohol or other downers. We have no specific new serious harm to report, so we suggest it stays a Heads Up.
entries.uncertainty: Samples are chosen by the people sending them in, so we can't say what share of tablets are affected. Most tramadol tablets were received in June and July. WEDINOS doesn't give the amounts.
advice: Tablets can look exactly like the real thing. Get them tested if you can.
Start with part of a tablet and wait.
Don't mix with alcohol, opioids, GHB/GBL or other depressants. A fake Xanax may already contain an opioid.
Take care with memory loss, as it's easy to forget how much you've had.
If someone can't be woken or is struggling to breathe, call 999 and put them in the recovery position. Give naloxone if you have it.

history.change: Approved by Jimmy
Updated with tramadol found in fake Xanax and the latest ethylbromazolam samples. Stays a Heads Up. Update approved by Jimmy

entries.title: Methamphetamine in fake Adderall, and in drugs sold as MDMA, ketamine or Xanax, in the UK
entries.summary: WEDINOS has found methamphetamine in four tablets sold as Adderall, and in samples sold as MDMA, ketamine and Xanax. Methamphetamine is stronger and lasts much longer than the amphetamines in real Adderall, and is nothing like ketamine or Xanax.
entries.sold_as: Adderall tablets. Also MDMA (crystal and granules), ketamine (crystal) and Xanax (tablet)
detected: With MDMA, MDA or ketamine in some samples
With ethylbromazolam in the Xanax tablet
entries.sample_ref: WEDINOS Adderall: W105259, W104940, W102891, W101612. Sold as MDMA: W105863, W103511. Sold as ketamine: W101523. Sold as Xanax: W101763
entries.location_detail: England only so far. Postcodes given with the samples: B31, EX10, CV4 and BA14 (Adderall), BS4 and W5 (MDMA), NN11 (ketamine) and CT68 (Xanax). Those are samples sent in, not proof of where the drugs are sold.
entries.original_warning_level: No warning level. WEDINOS sample results
entries.why_classified: A UK lab has now confirmed methamphetamine in eight samples sold as other drugs, across England. People who think they're taking Adderall, MDMA, ketamine or Xanax won't expect a strong, long-lasting stimulant. It's no longer two samples, so we suggest moving it from One to Watch to Heads Up. We have no reports of serious harm linked to these samples.
entries.uncertainty: Eight samples, chosen by the people sending them in. WEDINOS doesn't give the amounts. Most were received in June to September, and we don't know how many are around now.
advice: Tablets and powders not from a pharmacy can be something else. Get them tested if you can.
Start with a small amount and wait.
Don't redose or mix with other stimulants or alcohol.
If you can't sleep or feel very wired for many hours, don't take more. Methamphetamine lasts much longer than most stimulants.
If someone overheats, has chest pain, a very fast heartbeat or a fit, call 999.

history.change: Approved by Jimmy
Updated with 6 more WEDINOS samples, now also sold as MDMA, ketamine and Xanax. Moved from One to Watch to Heads Up. Update approved by Jimmy

entries.title: 2-oxo-PCE sold as ketamine in the UK
entries.summary: WEDINOS has found 2-oxo-PCE, a much less researched ketamine-like drug, in two samples of white crystal sold as ketamine. No ketamine was found.
entries.location_detail: Both samples gave postcode BS49, received 4 Sep 2026. Could be the same batch. That shows where the samples were sent from, not proof of where it is sold.
entries.original_warning_level: No warning level. WEDINOS sample results
entries.why_classified: A UK lab has confirmed a different drug sold as ketamine. It's much less researched and may not feel or dose the same. It's two samples from one postcode, so we suggest watching it.
entries.uncertainty: Possibly one batch. WEDINOS doesn't give the amounts. We don't know how far it has spread.
advice: Get ketamine tested if you can.
Start with a very small amount and wait, as it may be stronger or last longer than you expect.
Don't mix with alcohol or other depressants.
Don't use alone or near water or traffic.
If someone can't be woken or is struggling to breathe, call 999 and put them in the recovery position.

history.change: Approved by Jimmy

entries.title: Very strong ecstasy pills: up to 304 mg of MDMA in Slovenia and Vienna
entries.summary: DrogArt in Slovenia found 304 mg of MDMA in a Squid Game pill on 6 November. checkit! in Vienna found up to 243 mg in a blue Cookie Monster pill, and more than 170 mg in several others. That's two to three times a typical adult dose in one pill.
detected: MDMA (304 mg, Squid Game pill, DrogArt)
MDMA (186 mg and 243 mg, blue Cookie Monster pills, checkit!)
MDMA over 170 mg in Gengar, Angry Bird, Lacoste and Punisher pills (checkit!)
entries.sample_ref: DrogArt result 6 Nov 2026, "Squid game (MDMA)". checkit! report KW45 2026 (https://checkit.wien/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/checkit_Warnungen_2026_KW45.pdf)
entries.location_detail: Slovenia (Squid Game pill, place not given) and Vienna, Austria (blue Cookie Monster pill, Cookie Monster on both sides, about 436 mg). Not found in UK results in our data so far, but WEDINOS doesn't publish amounts.
entries.why_classified: Two labs have confirmed pills with two to three times a typical dose. Very strong pills are a common cause of overheating and serious harm at events, and the same logos can turn up in the UK. None has been found in UK results in our data, so we suggest watching it rather than a Heads Up.
entries.uncertainty: We don't know if these pills are in the UK. The same logo can hold very different amounts, even in one batch: checkit!'s two Cookie Monster pills held 186 mg and 243 mg.
advice: Get your pills tested if you can. In the UK you can post a sample to WEDINOS.
Start with a quarter or half a pill and wait at least 2 hours before taking more.
Take breaks from dancing, sip water (about a pint an hour if you're dancing) and don't mix with alcohol.
If someone overheats, is very confused, has a fit or collapses, call 999 straight away.

history.change: Approved by Jimmy
